To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have found that neutrinos produced by weak processes in a proto-neutron star are strongly affected by the strong magnetic field and that the resultant asymmetry of the neutrino distribution due to neutrino absorption and the scattering process becomes larger by the additional production process.
the neutrino production increases emitted neutrinos in the direction parallel to a magnetic field and decreases those in the opposite direction.
the neutrino production increases neutrinos along the field direction, and that the asymmetry due to neutrino production and absorption/scattering processes becomes larger.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the neutrino production and absorption processes in a proto-neutron star under the strong magnetic field.
the neutrino production in the magnetized neutron-star matter in the relativistic approach.
the effect of the neutrino emission process on the proto-neutron star cooling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the magnetic field enhances the asymmetry of neutrinos and the asymmetry of the neutrino distribution in the magnetic field is larger than that without the field.
the asymmetry due to neutrino absorption and the magnetic field is not enough to account for the observed asymmetry of the cosmic microwave background radiation.
the magnetic field has a significant effect on the neutrino production and the resultant asymmetry of neutrino fluxes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the neutrinos emitted along the direction parallel (antiparallel) to the magnetic field are more (less) likely to be absorbed by the matter.
the magnetic field in the proto-neuron star enhances the asymmetry of the neutrino distribution.
the asymmetry of the neutrino distribution is larger for the larger neutrino production rate and larger magnetic field.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the asymmetry of the neutrino distribution in proto-neutron stars is enhanced by the neutrino production.
the neutrino production can play a crucial role in determining the neutrino flavor asymmetry in the proto-neuron stars and the subsequent nucleosynthesis.
the neutrino production in the magnetic field plays a significant role in the asymmetry of neutrinos in the proto-neutrino star.
